q: During my pregnancy, when I would hear the term “mom guilt” I thought it was going to feel like failing to live up to societal standards. Basically, I assumed it meant I was going to feel the pressure to be perfect through comparison to other mothers.
cx: New mother explaining that the phrase she heard in pregnancy meant something different once the baby came.

q: Being a mom is nothing like I expected, but everything I hoped for.
cx: Same post, after listing small moments of guilt with her baby.

q: My bf is employed but due to the circumstances where we refuse to get daycare since it’s so expensive, he will be the one providing for us. That being said, there’s a large chance we will have to move further away from family and friends.
cx: First-time mother planning to stay home; boyfriend's job search may move them away from family.

q: Thinking about the fact that we will possibly be moving over an hour away from the only support systems we have is stressing me out. Being a ftm in a city where I don’t know anyone, being at home with our baby..
cx: Same post; already hard to get people to visit 30 minutes away.

q: My mom said eww that’s a dogs name because some YouTuber she’s subscribed to dog’s name is Nova. So it automatically deemed a dogs name. And she’s asks me once a month about names and when I tell her it’s the same it hasn’t changed, she goes “ok well just name your daughter a dogs name”
cx: Pregnant with a girl, already has a son; family and OB all dislike her chosen name.

q: My OB asked about names I had in mind and I told her and her response was that’s a boys name and she had a patient last year name their son Nova.
cx: Same post; even the OB commented on the name.

q: since I’ve gotten the negative feedback I’ve just stop telling people when they and tell them I haven’t decided and have nothing really in mind lol.
cx: Her way of handling relatives' comments on the name.

q: I just bought my going home outfit and some dresses for a maternity photo shoot. I also have a memory book and a book of firsts.
cx: First baby due in August; feels the important things are handled and asks about keepsakes and regrets.

q: I’m curious if anyone has looked back and said “ugh I wish I did that” when they were pregnant/first gave birth in regards to pictures, outfits, memory books etc.
cx: Same post asking others for looking-back regrets.

q: I feel guilty for not researching more before taking it. Anyway, I ended up reading that antibiotics during pregnancy cause epilepsy, asthma, and autism, and I panicked.
cx: Took an antibiotic early in pregnancy that she later learned she didn't need; reading online made it worse.

q: Can anyone recommend any good multivitamins that haven’t caused this side effect in you? Don’t want to waste money and they tend to be expensive.
cx: UK; her pregnancy multivitamin upsets her stomach and she wants a switch without wasting money.

q: Mom strongly encouraged us to do so, and when I said I didn't want to, I was told that I worry too much and don't I want support?
cx: Around 6 weeks; her mother keeps pushing her to tell church and family before 12 weeks.

q: My sister then told me that if I didn't want EVERYONE to know, then I shouldn't have told people. My jaw was practically on the floor.
cx: After learning her small church discussed the news before she told a friend.

q: Am I being dramatic? I just feel like once I told my mom, the decision was no longer mine to make.
cx: Same post; she wanted only immediate family told until 12 weeks.

q: I hate how easy it is for people who don't have my experience with breastfeeding to suggest that I just need to give it another try for this baby.
cx: Four days after a second birth; relatives urge breastfeeding after her first time went badly.

q: I’m terrified of going through postpartum in a new town, during a Canadian winter, away from my closest friends, while also dealing with a move and buying our first house.
cx: Canada, 8 weeks; husband's dream job offer would mean moving around her January due date.

q: I’m 25+2 and I feel like my symptoms are getting worse with time.  I was nauseous in the first trimester but for the past month or so I am throwing up daily.
cx: Asks if anyone else found the second trimester worse than the first.
